audience: service businesses that manage bookings, check-ins and payments in reenio

useCases.title: Check tomorrow's reservations
useCases.text: List reservations in a period, filtered by place, service or employee. Read one reservation for its customer, price and paid flag.

useCases.title: Look up a reservation from its check-in code
useCases.text: Find a reservation by its code, for example from a QR code, and read its tickets and state.

useCases.title: Review payment documents for the accountant
useCases.text: List invoices and receipts whose payment was completed in a period, or the documents linked to one reservation.

useCases.title: Change reservation states and paid flags
useCases.text: Move a reservation to another state, mark it paid or unpaid, or cancel it. A paid reservation cannot be cancelled.

useCases.title: Block a time for training or an external calendar
useCases.text: Block a time so reservations are not possible, and delete the block to open that time again.
